title: Prime Minister's Office (National Security Coordination Secretariat)
what_it_is: Prime Minister's Office (National Security Coordination Secretariat)

sections.label: Traditional and emergent security threats
sections.summary: Traditional threats like terrorism, subversion and espionage remain, while disinformation and COVID-19 add to vulnerabilities of Singapore's multi-racial society.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Traditional threats to national security in areas like terrorism, foreign subversion, and espionage remain.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Emergent, cross-domain threats, like the rapid spread of disinformation on the internet, add to and amplify existing vulnerabilities of our multi-racial, multi-religious society.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: COVID-19 has also added pressure in many areas, including to our supply chains and our social resilience.

sections.label: Securing critical flows and supplies
sections.summary: NSCS will draw COVID-19 lessons to strengthen long-term pandemic capabilities, as border closures and geopolitical tensions threaten critical supplies and Singapore's trading hub position.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: NSCS will also work with agencies to draw lessons from COVID-19 to strengthen our long-term capabilities to deal with pandemics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: The COVID-19 crisis has accentuated our need to secure such flows, as countries close their borders and restrict the export of critical goods.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Geopolitical tensions in areas like international trade could also affect our ability to secure critical supplies and impact our position as an international transport and trading hub.

sections.label: Whole-of-nation pandemic readiness
sections.summary: Learning from COVID-19, NSCS will strengthen whole-of-nation capabilities and readiness for future pandemics through health surveillance, crisis response capacity and resilient facility design.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: Learning from COVID-19, NSCS will work to strengthen our whole-of-nation capabilities and readiness to deal with future pandemics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: These will include enhanced health surveillance, increased capacity for crisis response and healthcare, and more resilient design of key facilities and essential services against pandemics.
